page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.2xlarge is an x86_64 cloud instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It provides 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs with 2 threads per core, backed by 32 GB of RAM representing 4 GB per core. The CPU features a 33 MB L3 cache, 1 MB L2 cache per core, and hardware support for AVX, AVX-512, AES, and BMI2 instruction sets. Storage is integrated with a bundled 959 GB local SSD. Network connectivity is delivered via a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor environment.

Performance benchmarks show moderate output across specific I/O and entry-level execution scenarios, accompanied by processing tradeoffs in high-utilization compute tasks. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 7008.06 and handles 5.98 million Redis SET operations per second. Memory write speeds reach 35.51 GB/sec on large block transfers, and small model LLM prompt processing yields 445.76 tokens per second. Conversely, stress-ng multi-core tests, single-threaded compression, and medium-scale model inference fall into lower performance brackets due to base clock speeds and memory throughput constraints.

The inclusion of a 959 GB local SSD offers high local storage density per resource unit, avoiding reliance on network-attached block volumes for transient data operations. This architecture offers practical cost efficiency for workloads prioritizing localized disk access over raw compute speed. Recommended application areas include low-latency key-value databases, memory caching servers, local data processing pipelines, and general web serving.
